sections.Profile:
"Gondolier" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1958.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1958–1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Boats, Two player, Rivers, Travel, Women, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Animation: Wayne Neyens
- Design: Wayne Neyens
- Mechanics: Wayne Neyens
- Concept: Wayne Neyens
- Art: Roy Parker
sections.Editions:
- Gondolier: 900 made, released 1958-08-01, model number 147
- Serenade: released 1959-01-01
